label: Finite grades frames separate total-cause containment from q.4 a.2 preexistence (inference)
meaning: Distinct-statement verdict: neither total-cause containment nor STMT-PERFECTIONS-OF-EFFECT-PREEXIST-IN-CAUSE entails the other. Preexistence is about every perfection of an effect whose being a cause causes, partial causes included; total-cause containment is about the perfection a total cause causes. The gap from containment to preexistence is exactly the cause-of-being transfer (f8ba2429) together with containment for partial causes. Finite interpretations only.
